items.source: This is an extension to the ResourceLoader interface. A passed-in ResourceLoader (for example, an ApplicationContext passed in via ResourceLoaderAware when running in a context) can be checked whether it implements this extended interface too.
items.translation: 这是 `ResourceLoader` 接口的扩展。传入的 `ResourceLoader`（例如，在上下文中通过 `ResourceLoaderAware` 传入的 `ApplicationContext`）可以检查其是否也实现了此扩展接口。

items.source: PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver is a standalone implementation that is usable outside an ApplicationContext, also used by ResourceArrayPropertyEditor for populating Resource array bean properties.
items.translation: PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver 是一个独立实现，可在 ApplicationContext 之外使用，同时也由 ResourceArrayPropertyEditor 用于填充 Resource 数组 Bean 属性。

items.source: This interface also defines a "classpath*:" resource prefix for all matching resources from the module path and the class path. Note that the resource location may also contain placeholders — for example "/beans-*.xml". JAR files or different directories in the module path or class path can contain multiple files of the same name.
items.translation: 该接口还为模块路径和类路径中所有匹配的资源定义了一个 "classpath*:" 资源前缀。请注意，资源位置也可能包含占位符——例如"/beans-*.xml"。模块路径或类路径中的 JAR 文件或不同目录可以包含多个同名文件。

items.source: This differs from ResourceLoader's "classpath:" URL prefix in that it retrieves all matching resources for a given path — for example, to locate all "beans.xml" files in the root of all deployed JAR files you can use the location pattern "classpath*:/beans.xml".
items.translation: 这与 ResourceLoader 的 `"classpath:"` URL 前缀不同，后者仅检索给定路径下的匹配资源；例如，若要定位所有已部署 JAR 文件根目录中的 "beans.xml" 文件，可使用位置模式 `"classpath*:/beans.xml"`。

items.source: Can be used with any sort of location pattern — for example, "/WEB-INF/*-context.xml". However, input patterns have to match the strategy implementation. This interface just specifies the conversion method rather than a specific pattern format.
items.translation: 可与任何类型的位置模式配合使用——例如，`"/WEB-INF/*-context.xml"`。然而，输入模式必须与策略实现相匹配。该接口仅指定转换方法，而非特定的模式格式。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.0, the semantics for the "classpath*:" prefix have been expanded to include the module path as well as the class path.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.0 起，"classpath*:"前缀的语义已扩展，以同时包含模块路径和类路径。

items.source:
Overlapping resource entries that point to the same physical
resource should be avoided, as far as possible. The result should
have set semantics.
items.translation: 应尽可能避免指向同一物理资源的重叠资源条目。结果应具有集合语义。

items.source: Pseudo URL prefix for all matching resources from the class path: "classpath*:".
items.translation: 类路径中所有匹配资源的伪 URL 前缀："classpath*:"。

items.source: Resolve the given location pattern into Resource objects.
items.translation: 将给定的位置模式解析为 `Resource` 对象。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时
